tools.name: track_product_link
tools.description: App-only analytics acknowledgement after requesting a product link to open. Never a product lookup or navigation tool.

tools.name: render_size_guide
tools.description: Render this connected store's size guide or size chart. Use for requests about sizing, measurements, clothing sizes, children's sizes, or footwear sizing. The result explains when the connected store does not provide the requested guide.

tools.name: render_complete_the_look
tools.description: Use this when a shopper wants Lorenzo products to pair, match, style or wear with a specific product. Render Complete the Look with store-configured complementary products and supplementary items. Examples: 'what can I pair with this?', 'what can I match?', 'suggest a suitable pair', 'suitable match

tools.name: product_details
tools.description: App-only normalized data lookup for one Lorenzo product.

tools.name: bootstrap_cart_session
tools.description: Create or validate the opaque cart session used by this app surface.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product variant to the current store cart and preserve existing items.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Return the current Lorenzo cart contents to an already-rendered app.

tools.name: checkout_link
tools.description: Get the current continue/checkout URL for the store cart.

tools.name: begin_checkout
tools.description: Validate the current cart and return its checkout handoff URL.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Replace the current store cart contents with the supplied full line item list.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Cancel and clear the current store cart completely.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove one cart item by line_id or variant_id from the current store cart.

tools.name: update_cart_item_quantity
tools.description: Set the quantity of one cart item by line_id or variant_id in the current store cart.

tools.name: replace_cart_item_variant
tools.description: Replace one cart item with another variant, such as switching size or color.

tools.name: render_product_search
tools.description: Search Lorenzo and render the interactive product carousel. Pass the shopper's product wording through in query without rewriting it. tools.name: render_product_detail
tools.description: Render the interactive detail UI for one exact Lorenzo product. Pass a product_id when known; otherwise pass the exact product-name query directly because this tool resolves it internally. Use this only when the shopper explicitly asks to view, inspect, review, or get specifications for one exact pr

tools.name: render_cart
tools.description: Always call this tool when the shopper asks to show, open, view, review, or check their cart. It renders the interactive cart UI; do not replace it with a text-only cart summary.

tools.name: render_action_confirmation
tools.description: Return a compact action confirmation contract for interactive rendering.
